name: Thabo Mokoena
bio: Trained in Soweto and Cape Town. Thirteen years behind the chair and still the fussiest about a clean lineup.

name: Sipho Dube
bio: Straight-razor man. Sipho keeps the beard work and hot shaves at Ironbark honest and traditional.

name: Lerato Nkosi
bio: Calm hands, quick scissors. The one to ask for when little ones are getting their first proper cut.
